title: A flat finite presentation has a flat finitely presented integer model
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings and f : R → S a finitely presented ring map [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] which is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. There exist commutative rings P and Q, a P-algebra structure on Q and a P-algebra structure on R, such that P is finitely presented over Z, Q is finitely presented over P, P → Q is flat, and there is a ring isomorphism e : R ⊗_P Q ≅ S with e composed with the canonical map R → R ⊗_P Q equal to f. The universes of P and Q may be taken to be the maximum of those of R and S.

proof.text: Lift R and S to ULift in their common maximum universe. The private proved helper exists_flat_model_of_equiv conjugates f by the lift ring equivalences. FinitePresentation.of_bijective and Flat.of_bijective, together with the composition lemmas, preserve the hypotheses. This does not alter the requested universes or statement.

In exists_flat_model_same_universe, apply the proved source-library theorem Algebra.FinitePresentation.exists_fg_subalgebra_isPushout (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.FinitePresentation) to obtain a finitely generated integer subalgebra A₀ of A, a finitely presented A₀-algebra B₀, and a pushout with B. Finite type over the Noetherian integers makes A₀ Noetherian. The pushout equivalence e₀ identifies A ⊗[A₀] B₀ with B and transfers its flatness using Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv.

The proved private helper exists_flat_tensor_model applies PrimeSpectrum.exists_fg_forall_flat_localization_tensor_of_isCompact (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.LocalRing.ResidueField.Fiber) to the entire spectrum of A ⊗[A₀] B₀. It gives a finitely generated subalgebra T whose flat locus U contains every contracted prime from that spectrum. T is Noetherian and T ⊗[A₀] B₀ is finitely presented over T, so the proved source theorem PrimeSpectrum.isOpen_setOf_flat_localization makes U open.

Let J be the ideal generated by elements g with D(g) contained in U. Its image in A ⊗[A₀] B₀ is the unit ideal. Otherwise Ideal.exists_le_maximal gives a maximal ideal containing that image. Its contraction lies in U, and the basic-open basis gives g outside the contracted prime with D(g) contained in U. This g belongs to J, so its image belongs to the maximal ideal, a contradiction. This argument also covers the zero ring: a proper ideal would still give the contradictory maximal ideal.

Apply the proved source-library theorem Subalgebra.exists_map_tensorProduct_inclusion_eq_top (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.DirectLimitFG) to enlarge T to a finitely generated T′ where the image of J is already the unit ideal. The proved source lemma Algebra.FinitePresentation.flat_tensorProduct_of_map_eq_top (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Descent), using U and this equality, makes T′ ⊗[A₀] B₀ flat over T′. These are existing proved tools; no new existence theorem or arbitrary witness definition is introduced.

Set P = T′ and Q = T′ ⊗[A₀] B₀ in the existential conclusion. Algebra.IsPushout.tensorProductAlgebra and its scalar-tower and pushout lemmas give the pushout with A and B. The equivalence Algebra.IsPushout.equiv yields e : A ⊗[P] Q ≃ₐ[A] B, and e.commutes proves compatibility on the left inclusion. Finite presentation of Q is preserved by base change; P is finite type over the Noetherian integers, hence finitely presented.

Finally exists_flat_model_of_equiv transports the P-algebra structure from A to R along eA. Use Algebra.TensorProduct.congr with eA.symm and the identity on Q, and compose with the model equivalence and eB. Evaluating the model compatibility at eA.symm r and cancelling both equivalences proves the required equality with f pointwise. The main theorem specializes this helper to the two ULift ring equivalences.

mathlib_searches.query: Flat finitely presented algebra over a directed colimit descends to a flat algebra at some stage
mathlib_searches.results: RingHom.EssFiniteType.exists_eq_comp_ι_app_of_isColimit gives factorization only. RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff, Module.Flat.of_flat_tensorProduct and smoothness flatness results do not provide a finite integer model.

Mathlib has the finite-presentation factorization and eventual equality lemmas in Algebra/Category/Ring/FinitePresentation.lean; matches for coflat functors are unrelated. Source-library flat approximation results concern a specified fibre, not a globally flat integer model. No exact match in Sheaf; NoetherianFlatClosedFiberModel is a local module comparison, LimitFinitePresentation does not give flat models.

lean.statement: theorem exists_flat_finitePresentation_model {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (hfp : f.FinitePresentation) (hflat : f.Flat) : ∃ (P Q : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing P) (_ : CommRing Q) (_ : Algebra P Q) (_ : Algebra P R), Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P ∧ Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q ∧ (algebraMap P Q).Flat ∧ ∃ e : R ⊗[P] Q ≃+* S, e.toRingHom.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom) = f
